_readme: Plain-language usage of every database table, merged into docs/html/visualizeDB.html by SchemaCatalogExportTest. Every table in the schema MUST have an entry here (the generator fails otherwise). Columns, constraints, indexes, RLS and code references are read automatically; only describe purpose, feature, pages, APIs and what to check. Keep sentences short and non-technical.

features.Accounts & sign-in: People, their passwords and sign-in sessions.
features.Tenants & configuration: Customer tenants, their projects, subscription plans, connectors, dynamic properties and roles.
features.Media library: Videos and ad creatives, their processing, media types and the connected video library (Mux).
features.Rights: Where and when each video may play.
features.Channels & schedules: Linear channels, their draft and published schedules.
features.Smart programming: Rules that place series episodes daily and remember what was placed.
features.Advertising: Ad sources, direct-sold campaigns, ad decisions and delivery events.
features.Playback: Viewer sessions created when someone watches a channel.
features.Distribution & partners: Destinations, deliveries and sharing channels with partner organizations.
features.Monitoring & audit: Alerts and the audit trail of who changed what.
features.Email: Email templates and the log of sent emails.

pages./reset-password: Set a new password from a reset link

organization.purpose: Every customer project and every partner organization (plus the hidden platform organization). Almost every other table points here through org_id.
watch: kind CUSTOMER must have tenant_id; PARTNER and PLATFORM must not (check constraint).
status SUSPENDED blocks management (403 ORG_SUSPENDED) but channels keep playing.
slug must be unique: creating a project with a used slug returns 409 SLUG_TAKEN.

app_user.purpose: A person who can sign in. Passwords are stored only as hashes.
watch: email is unique and stored lower-case.
must_change_password = true forces a new password at next sign-in.
token_version changes sign everyone out of that account.

membership.purpose: Who belongs to which project or partner organization, and with which role (plus an optional custom role).
watch: No membership row = the person gets 404 for that organization (on purpose).
custom_role_key must match an enabled access_role of the same kind, or the member falls back to view-only.

refresh_token.purpose: Sign-in sessions (refresh tokens, stored as hashes) so the browser stays signed in and can be signed out everywhere.
watch: revoked_at or replaced_at set = that session can no longer refresh (user must sign in again).

password_reset.purpose: One-time password reset links (only the hash is kept). Expire after 24 hours.
watch: used_at set or expires_at in the past = 'link expired or already used'.

auth_attempt.purpose: Rate-limit log: one row per counted sign-in failure, reset-email request or bad partner/personal token, per account (email hash) or client address. Shared by all servers; rows older than a day are deleted hourly.
apis: Any call with Authorization: Bearer fsp_…
watch: 429 RATE_LIMITED = too many rows in the window for that bucket (login-email 5/5 min, login-ip 20/15 min, forgot-ip 10/h, client-ip 20/15 min; token-ip is only logged, never blocks).
To unlock someone early, delete their rows (bucket = limit name + ':' + key).

personal_access_token.purpose: Personal access tokens people create on their profile for scripts and MCP clients: one organization (or the platform), a role ceiling and an optional expiry. Only the token's SHA-256 hash is kept.
apis: Any call with Authorization: Bearer fsp_…
watch: 401 with a fsp_ token = revoked_at set, expires_at passed, the owner left the organization or is no longer a platform admin.
org_id null = platform scope (role_key PLATFORM_ADMIN).

customer_tenant.purpose: A customer account. Owns one or more projects, has a subscription plan and status.
watch: status SUSPENDED suspends every project of the tenant.
revision is an edit counter: a stale screen gets 409 STALE_CONFIGURATION.

subscription_plan.purpose: Plans the platform sells: how many projects and channels a tenant may have, and which feature switches are included.
watch: Channel creation fails with 409 PLAN_LIMIT when the tenant uses max_channels across all projects.
A plan cannot be reduced below a tenant's current usage (409 PLAN_IN_USE).

connector_definition.purpose: Connectors the platform offers (Mux, VAST, R2, or custom ones).
watch: enabled = false switches the connector off for everyone.
driver cannot change after creation.

tenant_connector.purpose: Which connectors the platform granted to each tenant.
watch: No row or enabled = false: the tenant's projects cannot use the connector (403 CONNECTOR_DISABLED).

project_connector.purpose: A project's own opt-in/opt-out of a connector its tenant has. No row = follows the tenant.
watch: enabled = false here disables e.g. library sync for just this project.

property_definition.purpose: Typed settings the platform defines (custom properties and built-ins like premiere time), with an optional global default.
watch: Built-in keys (programming.premiere_time, programming.weekdays, ads.personalized) cannot be disabled.
Secret defaults are encrypted and never shown.

tenant_property_value.purpose: A tenant's value for a property; projects inherit it unless they override.
watch: Values are JSON text ("20:00" with quotes for text, true/false for yes/no).

project_property_value.purpose: A project's own override of a property.
watch: Delete the row to go back to the tenant/global value.

access_role.purpose: Custom roles the platform defines for customer projects or partner organizations, always within a built-in role.
watch: enabled = false: members with this role can only view.

tenant_settings.purpose: Per-project media settings: enabled media types, default type and the viewer integration key. (Premiere time, weekdays and personalized ads moved to properties in V15; those columns are kept only for rollback.)
watch: revision mismatch on save = 409 STALE (someone else saved first).

media_type.purpose: The platform's list of media types (Movie, Episode, Short, Ad, Promo…) and how each is scheduled.
watch: A type not enabled for the project gives 'This media type is not enabled for your company.'

asset.purpose: Every video and ad creative of a project: metadata, cue points, processing status and where its media lives.
watch: status PROCESSING for a long time = look at its media_job rows (state, attempts, last_error) and the app log for ffmpeg errors.
status FAILED: status_detail says why.
Episodes must have unique series + season + episode (409 DUPLICATE_EPISODE).
Archive is blocked while the video is used (409 IN_USE).

media_job.purpose: Background work on a video (packaging into 5-second segments). Written together with the change that needs it; workers on any server take one row each, keep a lease alive and publish only while their fence still matches.
watch: Only one QUEUED/RUNNING/CANCEL_REQUESTED row per video (media_job_one_active); a second enqueue does nothing.
RUNNING with lease_until in the past = its server stopped; the reaper re-queues it within a minute.
QUEUED with next_run_at in the future = waiting for a retry (1, 5, 25, 125 minutes); FAILED after max_attempts.
A project runs at most 2 programme jobs at once (faststudio.media.jobs-per-project); the rest wait.
Finished rows are deleted after 30 days.

mux_account.purpose: A project's video library (Mux) connection. Token values are encrypted and never returned to the browser.
watch: No row = 409 LIBRARY_NOT_CONNECTED on sync.
webhook_secret missing = Mux webhooks get 404.

rights_policy.purpose: Where (countries) and when (licence window) each video may play, and whether ads are allowed.
watch: No row = rights status MISSING; empty allowed_countries = INCOMPLETE.
valid_until in the past = EXPIRED (schedule validation reports it).

channel.purpose: A linear channel of a project: look, countries, ad load, fallback video and which schedule version is on air.
watch: published_version_id empty = nothing published, channel cannot go live.
status LIVE is required to start playback (409 NOT_LIVE).

schedule_version.purpose: Schedule versions of a channel: number 0 is the editable draft, 1..n are published (immutable).
watch: revision is the draft's edit counter: a stale editor gets 412 STALE.
Exactly one version per channel should have status PUBLISHED.

schedule_entry.purpose: Items of a schedule version: programmes and ad breaks with exact start and end times.
watch: Overlapping entries or gaps are reported by schedule validation, not by the database.
Times are UTC in the database; the screens show the channel's timezone.

programming_rule.purpose: Rules like 'air series X daily at 20:00 on weekdays, from season 1 episode 1'.
watch: enabled = false pauses the rule; existing placements stay in the draft.

programming_occurrence.purpose: Which episode a rule placed on which date, so the next run continues the sequence.
watch: One row per rule and date (primary key): generating the same date twice is refused.

ad_source.purpose: A project's ad demand waterfall: direct-sold campaigns and external VAST ad servers, in order.
watch: kind VAST needs a tag_url (check constraint).
Platform-managed tag URLs are never shown to the project.

campaign.purpose: Direct-sold ad campaigns: creative, dates, countries, priority, CPM, audiences and frequency cap.
watch: The creative must be a READY asset of kind AD.
Only ACTIVE campaigns inside their dates are eligible.

ad_decision.purpose: The stored ad decision for one viewer session and one ad break, so every request for that break gets the same ads.
watch: One row per session and break (primary key).

ad_event.purpose: Ad delivery events (impression, quartiles, complete, slate) used for analytics and partner delivery reports.
watch: A COMPLETE only counts when the IMPRESSION of the same session/break/campaign also exists.

playback_session.purpose: One row per viewer who started watching a channel: country, destination, ad mode and (with consent) viewer audiences.
watch: personalized_until in the past = only contextual ads.

destination.purpose: Where a project's channels are delivered (its own web player or partner TV platforms) and their ad rules.
watch: Every project gets a 'Web player' destination when it is created.

publication.purpose: Delivery attempts of a channel to a destination, with the result of the pre-flight checks.
watch: simulated = true: no real partner was contacted.

partner_link.purpose: A project sharing channels and data scopes with a partner organization (invited, active or revoked).
watch: status INVITED: the partner sees nothing until a partner admin accepts.
Only one non-revoked sharing per project and partner (409 ALREADY_SHARED).

partner_link_channel.purpose: Which channels a sharing includes (only when it is not 'all channels').
watch: Empty for an 'all channels' sharing.

api_client.purpose: Machine access for partner organizations: a client id and a hashed secret exchanged for short-lived tokens.
watch: revoked_at set = token requests fail with invalid_client.

alert.purpose: Problems the platform found (failed deliveries, expiring rights, processing failures…), with a suggested fix.
watch: dedup_key keeps one open alert per problem; the scanner re-opens it if the problem is still there.

audit_event.purpose: Who changed what and when (and partner reads of shared data). Never edited, only added to.
watch: via_org_id is set when a partner organization did the action.
id is an automatic counter (bigserial).

email_template.purpose: Platform-edited email texts. No row = the built-in text from the code is used.
watch: Delete the row to go back to the built-in text.

email_message.purpose: Every email the platform sent or tried to send. One-time passwords and links are hidden in the logged copy.
watch: status SAVED = no mail server configured; the email waits in the outbox.
FAILED with pending_text = can be retried.
